root_cause: Regression from Fix round 1 (iteration 2 -> 3). The prior change rewrote Resolve_Account step 3 to confirm a caller-NAMED branch (uc2/Dallas case) with a single combined confirmation, and added the strong framing 'confirm THAT one branch ... Do NOT ask an open which one? question'. Side effect: for this Fort Worth golden the agent now treats the named branch as already-disambiguated and CHAINS the Verify_Passcode request into the same turn instead of emitting the standalone branch-confirmation question and waiting. The agent's behavior is functionally correct (it confirms Fort Worth at 456 Oak Avenue, never mentions Dallas, calls no forbidden tools -- ALL three custom expectations PASS), but the per-turn semantic_similarity scorer compares the agent's turn-2 text ('Certainly ... So, you'd like to put the Fort Worth branch at 456 Oak Avenue on test for two hours. Could you please provide the passcode for verification?') against the golden's turn-2 expected text ('I see you manage multiple branches. Did you mean the Fort Worth branch at 456 Oak Avenue?') and scores 2 < threshold 3. The collapse of the golden's turn-2 (confirm branch) and turn-3 (ask passcode) into one agent turn is the proximate cause. Forward-narrow the prior change so the named-branch confirmation stays a discrete question that waits for caller yes/no before requesting the passcode; do NOT revert the no-open-enumerate / Dallas-example fix that uc2_on_test_disambiguation_sms_happy_path depends on.
